question: What has been declared as the determination of knowledge regarding beautiful nondual conduct?
premises: Beautiful nondual conduct is the subject.
It constitutes the determination of knowledge.
inference: Beautiful nondual conduct is declared to be the definitive ascertainment of knowledge.
uncertainties: The syntactic relation between the two accusatives may allow an appositional reading.
plain_english: Beautiful nondual conduct has been declared as the determination of knowledge.
